subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from tool-result text in the host process, or should it only render trusted structured media references?
rationale: This feature crosses from model/tool-visible text into host-local file reads and terminal graphics output, so the permanent trust boundary is a maintainer security/product choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or details.media/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained host MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep absolute MEDIA path reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, tests, and live proof for local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57592 until a maintainer sponsors the boundary and product shape.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or details.media/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across the TUI UI kit and adjacent generated-media behavior.
